$description: WordCloud (platform/charts/WordCloud.jsx, word-cloud.css; library wave 9, lane A): its component tokens. Five word sizes from the type scale; grouped words take the categorical data-viz colors (data-plx-dataviz).

word-cloud-text.$description: Word cloud: a word without a group (the body text color, readable at every size).

word-cloud-font-family.$description: Word cloud: words are text, not values: the UI font (DM Sans).

word-cloud-large-font-weight.$description: Word cloud: the weight of the largest words (step 5).

word-cloud-size-1.$description: Word cloud: the smallest words (size step 1 of 5).

word-cloud-size-5.$description: Word cloud: the largest words (size step 5 of 5; the type scale's largest size).

word-cloud-active-underline-width.$description: Word cloud: the underline of the word in focus, under the pointer or selected.
